modmenu.descriptionTranslation.repair-sw: Client-side mod that swaps damaged Mending items into your offhand while you collect experience.
repair-swapper.midnightconfig.title: Repair Swapper Config
repair-swapper.midnightconfig.auto.toolt: Activates when experience orbs come close, for the time defined in the reset delay option
repair-swapper.midnightconfig.orbDetecti:
Activates before the orbs reach you, so no experience is wasted.
Set to 0 to only activate when picking up an orb.
repair-swapper.midnightconfig.resetDelay:
Delay after which to disable repair swapper. Paused while sneaking.
Set to 0 for no automatic disabling.
repair-swapper.midnightconfig.mainHandRe: Repair Swapper only works while holding this in your main hand
repair-swapper.midnightconfig.priority.t: Which damaged item gets repaired first
repair-swapper.midnightconfig.protectTot: Never swap out a totem held in the offhand
repair-swapper.midnightconfig.showHud.to: Shows the durability of the item being repaired above the offhand slot
repair-swapper.midnightconfig.excludedIt: Items that will never be swapped, e.g. minecraft:elytra
hud.repair-swapper.noRepairable: Repair Swapper not enabled. No repairable items!
hud.repair-swapper.requiresSword: Hold a sword in your main hand to enable Repair Swapper.
hud.repair-swapper.requiresWeapon: Hold a melee weapon in your main hand to enable Repair Swapper.
hud.repair-swapper.totemProtected: Repair Swapper not enabled: your offhand holds a totem.
hud.repair-swapper.restoreFailed: Your offhand changed, Repair Swapper left your items as they are.
